c01-bundle.chapter: II · Votes to One Man, Bundles to All
c01-bundle.note: The bundle: three sealed cords tied together, carried by a rat to the chink in the wall.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub. At dusk, close on a chink at the foot of a small ruined cyclopean dry-stone wall. A single brown rat stands at the chink, a bundle of three short cords tied together on its back, each cord ending in a small dab of sealing wax with its own stamped mark. Dry grass, stones. No people, no fire. Everything sharp.
